title: F02: Contracts: API schemas, error format, receipt lifecycle
milestone: M3 Extraction pipeline
labels: contracts, backend
---
## Goal
Fix the frontend/backend seam: request/response DTOs, the shared error format, the receipt lifecycle and the generated OpenAPI spec. Every documented endpoint exists as a typed stub that returns `501 not_implemented` until its feature is built ([0016](../../docs/wiki/decisions/0016-api-representation-and-stub-convention.md)).

**Depends on:** F01
**Built by:** Plan agent drafts, main session decides; `backend-dev` implements (authorised for `schemas.py` and `docs/openapi.json` in this feature only)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every endpoint in `contracts/api-endpoints.md` exists in `docs/openapi.json` with its request and response DTOs from `backend/app/api/schemas.py`; a test compares the documented tables with the spec in both directions
- [ ] Every non-2xx response, including routing 404/405, validation 422 (with `fields`) and unhandled 500, uses `{error, detail, fields}`; no stack traces, exception text or paths
- [ ] One code-to-status mapping in `backend/app/api/errors.py`; every `BudgieError` code has a status
- [ ] Unbuilt endpoints answer `501 not_implemented` naming their feature; stub routers import only `app.api.schemas`, `app.api.errors`, `app.errors`
- [ ] Money serialises as a JSON number with ≤ 2 decimals; request DTOs reject unknown fields; response DTOs always contain every key
- [ ] `not_a_receipt` is a receipt error code; manual entry for a failed receipt (`ExpenseCreate.receipt_id`) is in the contract ([0015](../../docs/wiki/decisions/0015-non-receipt-is-a-failure-with-retry-or-manual-entry.md))
- [ ] `python-multipart` added; `docs/openapi.json` regenerated and the drift check passes; `make check` passes
- [ ] `contracts/` pages marked final; decisions 0015 and 0016 recorded
